title: Python SCHC receiver remains unauthenticated and absent from production Node
description: python/schc/reassembly.py accepts raw caller-keyed bytes with no Link RxFrame evidence, signer/local-identity/generation/replay binding, terminal tombstone/hold-down, or authenticated idempotent response. It can allocate/mutate state and emit aborts from unauthenticated input, contradicting the strengthened fragmentation spec. Node routes Rule 0x78/0x79 through generic decompression failure, so production cannot receive fragmented SCHC. Integrate Link-owned authenticated receiver sessions into Node with bounded state, replay/rekey/reboot/abort behavior and shared interop vectors; unauthenticated input must be silent.
notes: Independent correctness rereview findings: version transitions invalidated senders but retained receiver partials/tombstones; stale/unsolicited ACKs fell into receiver parsing and emitted aborts; capacity rejection could emit repeated aborts without bounded hold-down. Fixed with exact regressions; retain in final review scope.
